intro: From the basics to the demanding topics, with exercises, graphs and animations. This is the book I'm writing, published here one chapter at a time.

levels.name: Foundations
levels.blurb: The language of physics: quantities, motion and forces. No prior physics needed.

chapters.title: Measuring the Universe
chapters.summary: Units, orders of magnitude and the art of the estimate.

chapters.title: Motion in one dimension
chapters.summary: Position, velocity and acceleration, and the equations that link them.

chapters.title: Projectile motion
chapters.summary: Split the motion in two and a thrown ball becomes easy.

chapters.title: Forces and Newton's laws
chapters.summary: Why things move the way they do.

chapters.title: Work and energy
chapters.summary: The quantity that is never lost.

levels.name: Intermediate
levels.blurb: Oscillations, waves and light. Some calculus helps.

chapters.title: Oscillations
chapters.summary: Springs, pendulums and simple harmonic motion.

chapters.title: Polarisation of light
chapters.summary: The hidden direction of light, Malus's law and the Stokes parameters.

levels.name: Advanced
levels.blurb: Electromagnetism and scattering, the physics behind my research.

chapters.title: Maxwell's equations
chapters.summary: Electricity, magnetism and light as one theory.

chapters.title: Rayleigh scattering
chapters.summary: Why the sky is blue and polarised, derived from a tiny oscillating dipole.

chapters.title: Radiative transfer
chapters.summary: Light travelling through an atmosphere, scattered many times.
